versions.content: Name V2x Fac_ Traffic Rule Type Kind Type Derived from uint8 Range V2XFAC_ TRAFFICRULE_ NO_ PASSING 0x00 Overtaking is prohibited for all vehicles V2XFAC_ TRAFFICRULE_ NO_ PASSING_ FOR_ TRUCKS 0x01 Overtaking is prohibited for trucks V2XFAC_ TRAFFICRULE_ PASS_ TO_ RIGHT 0x02 Vehicles should pass to the right lane V2XFAC_ TRAFFICRULE_ PASS_ TO_ LEFT 0x03 Vehicles should pass to the left lane Description Enumeration of DE_ Traffic Rule as defined in ETSI TS 102 894 - 2. Variation -- Available via Rte_ V2x Fac_ Type.h
